# Overalls

> Overalls is an open-source (MIT), self-hosted platform for persistent Firecracker development machines and the AI agents that work on them. Guest images include NixOS, Ubuntu, Arch Linux, AlmaLinux, FreeBSD, OmniOS (illumos) and Windows. There is no hosted service; you run it on your own x86_64 bare-metal hardware with NixOS. Source: https://github.com/ghuntley/overalls (trunk)

## Site

- [Home](https://overalls.dev/index.html): what Overalls is, features with status labels (STABLE, PREVIEW, EXPERIMENTAL), guest operating systems, Mila desktop/mobile preview, FAQ
- [Architecture](https://overalls.dev/architecture.html): components (Marshall, Lilly, Porsche, Audi, Brady, Enrico, Galileo, Ziggy, Lyra, Marvin, Mila, Susan, Peach and Protocol), control plane, machine lifecycle, guest edge services

## Self-hosting guide

- [Overview and requirements](https://overalls.dev/self-host/index.html)
- [Provision a host](https://overalls.dev/self-host/provision.html): `tools/buck2 run //:host -- discover | plan | install | enroll | verify`
- [Deploy the control plane](https://overalls.dev/self-host/deploy.html): Buck2 builds, NixOS modules, secrets, PostgreSQL, SMTP, TLS
- [Set up DNS](https://overalls.dev/self-host/dns.html): apex A records per Marshall host, ns1–ns8 for Audi, apps.<your-domain> NS delegation
- [Enroll hosts and images](https://overalls.dev/self-host/enroll.html): Lilly credentials, guest images, Porsche gateway
- [Your first machine](https://overalls.dev/self-host/first-machine.html): sign in, SSH keys, CLI, repository launch
- [Day-two operations](https://overalls.dev/self-host/operations.html): updates, drains, relocation, backups, logs
